model.name: R20.28: rb-file-detail shows 'Open in preview' + 'Open in new tab' buttons — rewire existing.
model.description: The file detail view (rb-file-detail) MUST render two action buttons: (1) 'Open in preview' — opens the file in the ContentPreviewer (image→show as img, html→sandboxed iframe, per R19.64/65). (2) 'Open in new tab' — opens the file content/URL in a new browser tab (window.open target=_blank). These buttons existed in the earlier file/ProfileSheet-era implementation — they must be REWIRED into the current rb-file-detail component (not built from scratch).

fix1_priority_metadata.bug: content-preview embed in rb-file-detail (line 60) calls renderContentPreview() which does mimeType dispatch — but the model.mimeType from the scenario unit may be empty/missing. When mimeType is falsy, renderContentPreview falls through to the download link (line 32), skipping image/url branches entirely. The PRIORITY metadata field (.priority or .metadata.priority) referenced by PO is NOT in the content-preview.ts dispatch at all — it has no priority-aware path.
fix1_priority_metadata.rootCause: rb-file-detail passes m.mimeType (line 36) from the scenario unit model. If the file was uploaded without mimeType detection (or the field name differs — e.g. contentType vs mimeType), it arrives as empty string → renderContentPreview matches nothing → download fallback.
fix1_priority_metadata.fix: In rb-file-detail.ts line 36: fallback chain: m.mimeType || m.contentType || guessMimeFromName(name). Add guessMimeFromName() to content-preview.ts that maps common extensions (.jpg/.jpeg→image/jpeg, .png→image/png, .gif→image/gif, .svg→image/svg+xml, .pdf→application/pdf, .html→text/html, .url/.webloc→text/uri-list, .json→application/json, .txt/.md/.ts/.js/.css→text/plain).

fix2_double_render_dup_buttons.bug: Both rb-detail-view (generic, line 143) AND rb-file-detail (specialized, line 60) call renderContentPreview for the same file UUID. If the drawer renders rb-file-detail INSIDE rb-detail-view, both fire → duplicate cv-url buttons.
fix2_double_render_dup_buttons.rootCause: rb-detail-view.renderFilePreview (line 142-148) inserts preview HTML after the preview-button, then removes the button. But rb-file-detail ALSO inserts preview HTML (line 60-66). If both components are in the DOM for the same file, two preview blocks render.
fix2_double_render_dup_buttons.fix: rb-detail-view must NOT embed content-preview when the detail is a File type. Check: if (type === "File" || this.querySelector("rb-file-detail")) return; in the file-meta fetch path (line 118). rb-file-detail owns the preview for files exclusively.
fix2_double_render_dup_buttons.file: rb-detail-view.ts (line 118 area — guard the file-meta fetch+preview for type !== File)

fix3_url_open_in_new_tab_blocked.bug: .url file "Open in new tab" button does not open. window.open(text, "_blank") at content-preview.ts:72 is blocked by popup blocker because it runs inside an async callback (fetch then window.open).
fix3_url_open_in_new_tab_blocked.rootCause: Browsers block window.open() when it is NOT in the synchronous call stack of a user gesture. The click handler (line 68) is async — it awaits fetch(), THEN calls window.open(). By then the user-gesture trust has expired.
fix3_url_open_in_new_tab_blocked.fix: Two-phase: (1) On wireUrlActions, pre-fetch the URL content at wire time (eager load, not on click). Store the resolved URL in a data attribute. (2) On click, read the pre-resolved URL synchronously and call window.open() — no async gap. Fallback: if pre-fetch failed, use a hidden <a href target=_blank> and .click() it (anchor clicks are not popup-blocked). Alternative: use location.assign() instead of window.open() for same-tab, but PO wants new tab.
fix3_url_open_in_new_tab_blocked.file: content-preview.ts wireUrlActions (line 51-75) — pre-resolve URL at wire time, synchronous window.open on click

fix4_jpg_no_buttons.bug: .jpg files render image preview but NO action buttons (Open in preview / Open in new tab). The image path (content-preview.ts line 14-15) returns only an tag — no buttons.
fix4_jpg_no_buttons.rootCause: renderContentPreview image branch (line 14) returns ONLY the img element. The URL-action buttons (Open in preview / Open in new tab) are ONLY in the text/uri-list branch (line 27). Images have no equivalent action buttons.
fix4_jpg_no_buttons.fix:
Add universal action buttons to ALL content types (not just URL files). After the type-specific preview element, append: "
". For images: preview-toggle hides/shows the inline img. new-tab opens the contentUrl directly. For text/pdf/html: preview-toggle shows/hides the existing preview. new-tab opens contentUrl. For url files: keep existing behavior (resolve URL first). Wire in wireUrlActions with a universal handler that checks the content type from a data attribute.
fix4_jpg_no_buttons.file: content-preview.ts — refactor: every branch appends cv-actions div. wireUrlActions wires all cv-actions universally.
